1_true_terminal_lifecycle_events.status: INVALID previously — applied ending_equity + terminal_adjustment after normal T0 run
1_true_terminal_lifecycle_events.correction: Implement research-only TerminalAwareResearchEngine (or lifecycle hook) — do NOT modify production PortfolioBacktestEngine. For every entity with terminal event: process all normal bars through final observed tradable session; AFTER that final observed session, if held, execute terminal lifecycle event exactly once. Event must mutate cash, position quantity, realized PnL, realized PnL events, portfolio equity, subsequent available capital, subsequent risk overlay, subsequent rebalances, holdings count, exposure. T1: realize last-observed-close minus normal sell costs. T2: 50% recovery. T3: zero. Sensitivity, not truth. No future exit (cannot sell before final tradable session due to future knowledge).
invariants: Stale last_price no longer contributes market value
No future SELL order for terminated position
1_true_terminal_lifecycle_events.tests_required: Prove quantity==0, position removed, no stale value, no future SELL

additional_required_corrections.terminal_reclassification_with_ca: Current 2389 POSSIBLE_DELISTING bucket too coarse. Use CA evidence to classify where possible: NAME_CHANGE/RENAME, CASH_MERGER, STOCK_MERGER, STOCK_AND_CASH_MERGER, REDEMPTION, WORTHLESS_REMOVAL, POSSIBLE_DELISTING, UNKNOWN. Verified rename/merger successor must not receive arbitrary haircut. T1/T2/T3 only for unresolved terminals.
additional_required_corrections.risk_geometry_invariants: Corrected FULL runs must audit ACTUAL holdings, not only targets. For every timestamp report managed gross exposure, actual total exposure, actual holdings count, target holdings count, stale/terminal holdings count. After lifecycle handling actual holdings must not systematically exceed max_positions=6 because of zombies. Actual managed exposure must respect frozen 60% sleeve, subject only to documented fill drift. If average holdings ~8 or exposure ~75% again: STOP and explain.
additional_required_corrections.terminal_event_accounting: Record EVERY case where V3 held an entity when its historical tradable life ended, not just final positions. For each: entity_id, symbol, entry date, final tradable date, quantity before event, account equity, T0 stale, T1/T2/T3 proceeds, realized impact. Report total held-at-termination EVENTS, unique entities.
additional_required_corrections.corrected_run_set: After dataset/lifecycle freeze, run OLD_T0, DEMO_T0, FULL_T0, FULL_T1, FULL_T2, FULL_T3 as complete path-dependent reruns. Report real return, CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, maxDD, maxDD duration, turnover, fees, avg/max actual exposure, avg/max actual holdings, ending equity, terminal events, dividend cash. T2/T3 Sharpe/maxDD must be recomputed from own curves. If byte-identical to T0 despite large losses: fail.
additional_required_corrections.verdict_rule: Do not inherit MODERATE. After corrected runs choose exactly one of STRONG/MODERATE/WEAK/INCOMPLETE. Until all corrections complete: verdict = INCOMPLETE.
